subtitle: Lesson 6 · The Weekly Sales & Fulfillment Report

code:
Total Sales = SUM ( Fact[LineTotal] )
Total Units = SUM ( Fact[OrderQty] )
Order Count = DISTINCTCOUNT ( Fact[SalesOrderID] )
Average Order Value = DIVIDE ( [Total Sales], [Order Count] )
caption: DIVIDE returns blank on zero orders instead of erroring.

code:
Prior Week Sales =
CALCULATE (
    [Total Sales],
    DATEADD ( 'Date'[Date], -7, DAY )
)
caption: Re-evaluates Total Sales inside a filter context shifted back 7 days.

code:
Total Sales (All Regions) =
CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], ALL ( TerritoryDim ) )

Pct of Company Total =
DIVIDE ( [Total Sales], [Total Sales (All Regions)] )
caption: ALL(TerritoryDim) strips the region filter on purpose, for a denominator.

subtitle: Two measures both starting with "Total Sales" are about to matter.
